text:
Elaine: Quick intake — customer wants automatic rollout gates driven by evaluation signals. Problem: post-rollout regressions observed in production that our current canary metrics don't catch. Need a PRD for an "eval-aware" rollout gate.
Sam: Clarifying q: are these evals synthetic prompt sets or user-derived labels?
Elaine: Mostly synthetic + a small labeled set from the customer. They want per-customer thresholds. Non-goal: full model retraining automation.
Jordan: Goal summary: 1) configurable per-customer eval thresholds, 2) automatic canary rollback when eval metric crosses threshold, 3) observability in Console + audit trail.
Maria: Acceptance criteria (draft): - UI/Config: per-model/per-customer threshold UI - Controller: automatic rollback trigger + reason code recorded - Alerts: console alert + email on rollback - Logs: retention of eval diffs for 30d
Dave: Edge cases to call out: noisy spikes due to infra flakiness, missing labels on some prompts, small sample sizes during low traffic, differing metric definitions between host and customer.
Sam: Metric suggestions: F1 on labeled set, BLEU-esque for structured outputs, and a fallback semantic-similarity score for unlabeled prompts. Need clear defaults.
Jordan: Implementation note: rollout controller should sample N=200 evals per window, compute metric and 95% CI. Use smoothing to avoid single-window flaps.
Elaine: Success metrics for feature launch: - <2% false-positive rollbacks in controlled canaries - detection time <15m for real regressions - customers hit <5% impact on p99 latency from eval runs
Maria: Test plan items: - Simulate infra noise + ensure no rollback - Simulate real regression and verify rollback within time window - Audit log entries accessible via Console search
Sam: Ops question: where do eval runs execute? Hosted infra or customer private? For private deployments we need a different runner.
Elaine: Non-goal: building new private runner in scope 1. We'll support private via an agent in scope 2. Document this in PRD.
product-bot: Added PROJ-3421 to product backlog and assigned to Sam.
Jordan: Quick UI wire idea: a per-model "Eval gates" tab with thresholds, recent diffs, and a toggle for auto-rollback. I'll sketch by Wed.
Dave: Playbook: reuse existing rollback runbooks from eng-oncall, add steps for eval verification and manual override. @eng-oncall please review.
eng-oncall: Will review playbook and identify gaps by Thu.
Elaine: Next steps: Sam drafts PRD (problem/goals/non-goals/metrics/acceptance criteria) by EOW; Jordan drafts UI wires; Maria owns test plan; Dave + eng-oncall update runbook. I'll collate and post PRD link here when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
